name: lldPRD/LldR half-maximal lactate
source: Zuniga et al. 2021 (ALPaGA) [@zuniga2021]: wild-type lldPRD biosensor, EC50 ~1.6 mM

name: lldPRD Hill coefficient
source: No cooperativity reported for LldR; single-site Hill is the default. 9.23 assumed 2

name: pPepT/FNR half-maximal oxygen
source: Hojberg et al. 1999 [@hojberg1999]: FNR-family promoter half-maximal at 5e2 Pa = 0.49 % O2. 9.23 used 1.0 %, unsourced. Dominant driver at colonic mucosa (ST 0.736) -- see 2.5

name: pLux quorum Hill coefficient
source: Ramalho et al. 2016 [@ramalho2016]: pLux dose response fitted at four resolutions, n = 0.95-1.5, centre 1.0. 9.23 used 1.0 and 2.978 -- see 2.5

name: oxygen penetration from perfused surface
source: 9.23 MODEL_SPEC_4_3 section 2: 1 % O2 contour at 222 um in a 400 um nodule
used_for: no hypoxic core below this radius

name: oxygen in the hypoxic core
used_for: tumour reference; the 'not anoxic' half of the key binary

name: effector decay with the degron as built
source: Half-life 1.6 h; ~2.3x stronger than the optimum

name: intracellular pool ratio untagged over tagged
used_for: 88 % of SsrA's spatial benefit is this, not confinement

name: tagged effector retained inside a 400 um nodule
used_for: delivery penalty in the dose back-calculation

name: net dose-kill exponent (net of gfp)
source: Block 5, GSDMD-SsrA net of gfp, log-log fit, r2 0.9956. Bounds are the two control choices

name: induced 24 h OD untagged over tagged
source: Blocks 1-2, aerobic + lactate. Forecast from t <= 12 h reproduces it to 0.41 %

name: per-OD killing untagged over tagged
source: Block 5 at 10 OD, both constructs in the same block

name: selectivity index CT26 over L929
source: Block 6 internal pairing only, n=3, p < 0.001. The 11.4x and 2.97x figures are withdrawn

name: CT26 volume doubling time
source: Murine line; two orders of magnitude faster than the indication

name: colonic epithelial renewal cycle
source: Crypt-to-surface replacement. A cycle, so the rate is 1/T and not ln2/T

name: maximum reportable extrapolation
source: Declared before use; a power law has no threshold, so both directions are bounded
used_for: guard rail on the dose inversion

name: conservative exponent for margin claims
source: Credits the margin with no amplification at all
